description: Turn your Android device into a locked-down web page in fullscreen mode.

latest_release.name: v0.26.29
latest_release.body:
## Changes

- Added local file creation and combined renaming and UTF-8 editing in one dialog
- Added local file links by name, with a chooser for duplicate names
- Added image refresh to the long-press menu
- Added optional direct GPS for web pages, with recovery after sleep
- Fixed WebView crashes from malformed URLs and the text selection toolbar
- Improved Shizuku activation and content filter cache reliability

---

<details>
<summary>Pull requests</summary>

* refactor: replace hardcoded Android API levels with version constants by @nktnet1 in https://github.com/nktnet1/webview-kiosk/pull/385
* refactor: standardise full-user vs main-user terminology by @nktnet1 in https://github.com/nktnet1/webview-kiosk/pull/386
* fix: bound compiled filter cache dictionary and string lengths by @nktnet1 in https://github.com/nktnet1/webview-kiosk/pull/390
* fix: keep Shizuku activation visible without a running manager by @nktnet1 in https://github.com/nktnet1/webview-kiosk/pull/391
* fix: prevent WebViewAssetLoader crashes on malformed URIs (NullPointerException) by @nktnet1 in https://github.com/nktnet1/webview-kiosk/pull/394
* fix(ci): prefetch and cache Robolectric runtime artifacts by @nktnet1 in https://github.com/nktnet1/webview-kiosk/pull/395
* feat: refresh image on long press by @nktnet1 in https://github.com/nktnet1/webview-kiosk/pull/397
* feat: support unique filename aliases for local assets by @nktnet1 in https://github.com/nktnet1/webview-kiosk/pull/396
* fix: synchronise WebView lifecycle across sleep and wake - by @nktnet1 in https://github.com/nktnet1/webview-kiosk/pull/392
* fix: address WebView Kiosk release regressions by @nktnet1 in https://github.com/nktnet1/webview-kiosk/pull/399

</details>

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nktnet1/webview-kiosk/compare/v0.26.28...v0.26.29

Webview Kiosk is a free and open-source Android application for secure, kiosk-style web browsing. It can function as digital signage, a kid-friendly restricted browser, an immersive web reader, an interactive sign-up form, a home assistant dashboard, or simply a wall clock. Designed for small businesses and device owners who are looking for a simple and standalone Kiosk solution. ## Key Features ### Core / Standalone - Lock Task Mode (Pin): prevent access to your device's home screen, apps and status bar - Secure Settings: configurations are protected by biometrics, device credentials or custom password - URL Filtering: use regular expressions to control web access through a URL blacklist and whitelist - Export/Import: backup and restore user settings in Base64 or JSON format - Local files: display images, audio, video, HTML or PDF (using Mozilla's PDF.js) in kiosk mode - Default Launcher: use as the home app and launch other apps in lock task mode (kiosk) - JS Scripts: supports NFC (Near Field Communication), Eruda console, Dark Reader and custom scripts - Adblock: blocks ads and trackers using rules from uBlock Origin, AdGuard, EasyList and HaGeZi ### Remote Management / Enterprise 1. MQTT (Message Queuing Telemetry Transport) - Monitor events, update settings, execute commands and build custom automations - Requires an MQTT broker (e.g. Mosquitto, EMQX, HiveMQ, or their HomeAssistant integrations) 2. UnifiedPush - Send commands and update settings via a decentralised push notification system - Requires a distributor application (e.g. sunup, ntfy, gCompat-UP) 3. Managed Configurations (App Restrictions) - For fully-managed (company-owned) devices, settings can be configured via an MDM/EMM provider - Advanced users with a device policy controller (e.g. Test DPC or OwnDroid) can also enforce configurations locally ## Permissions - INTERNET: general web browsing - ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE: refresh web pages when network connectivity is restored - ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK: (optional, Android 17+) web apps needing LAN - CAMERA: (optional) web apps requiring photo/video capture - RECORD_AUDIO: (optional) web apps requiring audio capture - MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS: routing audio - needed for microphone - ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION: (optional) web apps requiring precise geolocation - ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION: (optional) web apps requiring approximate geolocation - NFC: read/write NFC tags using hardware - VIBRATE: (optional) web apps requiring navigator.vibrate(pattern) - INSTALL_SHORTCUT: home screen launcher shortcuts on Android 7.1 and below - QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES: find launchable apps, device owners and lock task packages - POST_NOTIFICATIONS: (optional) for lock task mode launches and MQTT - FOREGROUND_SERVICE: persistent notification for required services - FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE: return mechanism after opening apps in kiosk - FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK: background audio/video streaming, e.g. YouTube - USE_BIOMETRIC: replaces USE_FINGERPRINT from Android 9.0 onwards - USE_FINGERPRINT: fingerprint hardware for authentication - WAKE_LOCK: (optional) wake screen when receiving MQTT commands - WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE: download files in Android 9.0 and below - API (Dhizuku): request shared owner privileges - API_23 (Shizuku): auto-activate device/profile owner ## Installation Notes From [v0.17.0](https://github.com/nktnet1/webview-kiosk/releases/tag/v0.17.0), Google Play's [automatic protection](https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/10183279) has been intentionally disabled to allow installations from the Aurora Store. From [v0.15.7](https://github.com/nktnet1/webview-kiosk/releases/tag/v0.15.7), the package name for all installation sources except the Google Play Store has changed from `com.nktnet.webview_kiosk` to `uk.nktnet.webviewkiosk`. ## Contact - support@webviewkiosk.nktnet.uk ## License This project is licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 or later. See the [LICENSE](./LICENSE) file for details. ## Screenshots
         
## Alternatives - [Fully Kiosk Browser Lockdown](https://www.fully-kiosk.com) (feature-rich, but not a free kiosk solution) - [Web Kiosk](https://github.com/screenlite/web-kiosk) (by Screenlite) - [FreeKiosk](https://github.com/RushB-fr/freekiosk) (by Rushb-fr) - [Kite AOS](https://github.com/andrew-malitchuk/kite-aos) (by andrew-malitchuk)
